summary: Round-1 MINOR src/table/session-report.ts:buyin-not-tied-to-stake is fixed. parseSessionReport now throws invalid('cash.buyIn') unless amount === buyIn({ smallBet, bigBet }), so reads enforce the same invariant that writes use. tests/table/session-report.test.ts covers this. App.tsx change: endSession now runs from an effect of the 'ending' screen, keyed on the sessionId carried in the screen state. That id comes from useTableSession (app-generated, not user input). The endingId ref stops a second effect run (StrictMode) from ending the same session twice, and endSession is still guarded by its strict readwrite transaction plus write-once add(). A rejection still fails closed to Home. The leave() double-click guard (tableKey) is unchanged. The new e2e test only holds grade replies to test ordering, so it adds no production surface. No new dependencies, secrets, sinks or randomness. No BLOCKER or MAJOR.
